{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Drops Boost.Test from CMake, depends (depends/packages/boost.mk), Guix, and vcpkg configurations.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removing Boost.Test simplifies dependency configurations across CMake, depends, and Guix. The PR eliminates build-system packaging overhead and tooling complications (such as IWYU and clang-tidy support), representing worthwhile build-system simplification without addressing an active release or platform failure."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/ipc/test/ipc_tests.cpp only via a mechanical one-line header substitution.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits to IPC test files are mechanical header updates resulting from the test framework migration and do not touch IPC interfaces or behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp only via mechanical scripted-diff header updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Kernel test changes are purely mechanical header substitutions following from the test runner replacement and do not touch the kernel API or boundary."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Introduces custom in-tree test runner in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and migrates the entire unit test suite away from Boost.Test.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replacing Boost.Test achieves a long-standing architectural goal (tracked in #8670 and RFC #34666) that eliminates platform-specific quirks and improves failure diagnostics. It resolves concrete issues like undersized signal stacks (#36045) and establishes expression decomposition for clearer test failures, while setting the stage for future test concurrency improvements."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Matched build_linux.sh under contrib/guix, which is part of the build and Guix packaging system.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "No developer or offline utility tools are modified; touched contrib files are build and release packaging scripts."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches wallet unit test files only via scripted-diff header changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes in src/wallet/test are mechanical header replacements that do not affect wallet logic, interfaces, or behavior."
    }
  ],
